causal_loop_ctc.finding: Formal self-consistency and CTC-adjacent structures exist, while physical realization remains unestablished.
causal_loop_ctc.attention_reason: Need an explicit crosswalk between formal consistency witnesses, chronology protection, and any physicalization claim.

reverse_chronology.finding: JANUS reverse/spiral/tranception operators are epistemic or narrative operations and must not be promoted to physical retrocausality.
reverse_chronology.attention_reason: False-positive firewall is required because semantic reversal can resemble time-reversal language.

acausality.finding: Acausality is too broad to remain a single bucket; distinct physical and epistemic mechanisms risk being conflated.

indefinite_causal_order.finding: Process-matrix, quantum-switch, causal-nonseparability and indefinite-causal-order concepts have weak internal JANUS representation relative to the maturity of the external scientific lane.
indefinite_causal_order.attention_reason: Strong bridge criticality plus semantic isolation.

superdeterminism_measurement_dependence.finding: JANUS has neighboring Bell/measurement-independence ideas but lacks a dedicated superdeterminism / measurement-dependence organ.
superdeterminism_measurement_dependence.attention_reason: The missing branch can be confused with retrocausality unless explicitly separated.

microcausality.finding: Microcausality is weakly represented and should be used as a control/negative lane so QFT locality terminology is not confused with macroscopic time-reversal or future-to-past signalling.

A0.name: NO_CAUSAL_CLAIM
A0.definition: Correlation, ordering, association or description without an established causal edge.

A1.name: INDEFINITE_CAUSAL_ORDER
A1.definition: No single definite global A<B or B<A causal order is assumed or available for the process.

A2.name: RETROCAUSALITY
A2.definition: A later boundary condition, setting, or event participates in an account of an earlier state or outcome.

A3.name: CAUSAL_LOOP_CTC
A3.definition: A causal path returns to an ancestor event/state or is represented by a closed-timelike-curve consistency condition.

A4.name: MICROCAUSALITY_OR_LOCALITY_VIOLATION
A4.definition: A QFT/local-observable causal-commutation or locality issue; not automatically retrocausality.

A5.name: SUPERDETERMINISTIC_MEASUREMENT_DEPENDENCE
A5.definition: The statistical independence between hidden/state variables and measurement settings is relaxed; not identical to retrocausality.

interpretation.SEMANTIC_ISOLATION: How weakly the concept is connected to the JANUS graph after synonym expansion.
interpretation.EMPIRICAL_GAP: How important the unresolved observation/test is even if many conceptual links already exist.
interpretation.BRIDGE_CRITICALITY: How much confusion or missing explanatory structure is caused by absence of this node.
interpretation.DUPLICATE_COVERAGE: How much equivalent coverage already exists under another name or artifact.

attention_function.reason_for_upgrade: Pure graph degree would under-rank retrocausality because it is richly connected despite a major unresolved empirical gate, and could over-rank indexing artifacts that are merely missing synonyms.

two_new_spider_eyes.name: SUPERDETERMINISM
two_new_spider_eyes.question: What if prior state variables and measurement settings were never statistically independent?
two_new_spider_eyes.separation_rule: Do not collapse measurement dependence into retrocausality.

two_new_spider_eyes.name: INDEFINITE_CAUSAL_ORDER
two_new_spider_eyes.question: What if the order A<B versus B<A is not globally definite?
two_new_spider_eyes.separation_rule: Do not translate indefinite order into a claim that information travelled into the accessible past.

minimum_requirements: A result must be available and timestamped before the later intervention/event used as the alleged cause.
The later intervention must be independently selectable or otherwise operationally specified.
The pre-event record must survive preregistered controls, temporal jitter, spatial controls, permutation/shuffle tests, and leakage audits appropriate to the dataset.
Postselection or retrospective partitioning alone cannot count as signalling into the past.
Replication must distinguish a genuine accessible signal from a time-symmetric or bookkeeping representation.

analysis_of_analysis.why_dark_nodes_matter: JANUS does not treat missing links as embarrassment. Missing links reveal where the ontology, vocabulary, evidence graph, or search instrument is weak.
analysis_of_analysis.why_missing_links_are_not_proof: A failed connection can be caused by indexing gaps, terminology mismatch, duplicate records under unexpected names, incomplete repository coverage, or a genuinely absent concept.
ranking_assumptions: Dedicated internal representation is valuable when neighboring concepts are easy to conflate.
An unresolved empirical gate can outrank a semantically isolated concept even when the former has many graph edges.
External scientific maturity increases bridge criticality but does not itself establish any JANUS claim.
Control vocabularies are first-class nodes because they reduce false-positive semantic matches.
confirmation_bias_risks: Treating any reverse-time wording as retrocausal evidence.
Treating lack of search hits as ontological absence.
Treating mathematical consistency of CTC models as evidence for physical CTCs.
Treating indefinite causal order as past-directed communication.
Treating superdeterminism and retrocausality as synonyms.
Treating JANUS Spiral, reverse-reading, or narrative operators as physical causal mechanisms.
demotion_conditions: A supposedly dark node is found to have strong existing duplicate coverage under another canonical name.
The search gap disappears after synonym expansion without adding substantive new structure.
The external literature does not support a distinct operational or mathematical category.
A proposed bridge cannot be stated with a nontrivial falsifier or claim ceiling.
promotion_conditions: Independent registry anchors converge on the same missing bridge.
A distinct formal assumption can be isolated, such as measurement independence or definite causal order.
A preregisterable experiment or proof obligation can distinguish the node from neighboring explanations.
The node reduces false-positive interpretation elsewhere in JANUS.

claim_ceiling: This artifact is a map of JANUS coverage, missing bridges, and research priorities, not evidence that retrocausality, superdeterminism, indefinite causal order, CTCs, or acausal signalling physically occur.
Formal models, interpretations, simulations and semantic analogies must remain separated from physical evidence.
No-hit search results are provisional because indexing and vocabulary coverage can fail.
The TOPA Spider v2 rerun is pending; this file does not claim that the v2 frozen vocabulary has already been executed by the workflow.
The JANUS Spiral is an epistemic recursion with memory, not a physical causal loop unless separately established by evidence.
